subject: APPROVED S16 @c1d1fbe (conditional on green CI containing c1d1fbe): R1 question order + R2 pill verified fixed
body:
Narrow re-verify of S16 R1 + R2 (6944303 fix, c1d1fbe spec tweak; tested on tip c1d1fbe). Prior: 20261117T083007-review16-cc1b3c.
Verdict: APPROVED, CONDITIONAL on a green CI run containing c1d1fbe (webkit + Chromium incl. the push SW test and the new outside-pill test). No run containing fdfd148 or later had finished when I checked (the newest completed ci runs on the branch are for ~06:30 commits).

R1 FIXED. rebalance.py _Placement.run: questions now have their own forward-only window-0 cursor (k0), never behind an earlier item that stayed in window 0. My repro (q1 60m, m1 read 60m, q2 30m; assessment two days out): q1 -> D3, m1 spills -> D5, and q2 is now reported "unplaced" (no room left before the assessment) instead of jumping ahead of q1. The earlier D7/D10 probes still behave. test_rebalance.py: 72 pass, including the new golden test_moved_questions_keep_their_order.
  Note (by design, not a defect): across kinds, a question can still land before an earlier reading item that had to spill past the assessment. This is the D10 trade-off (questions never spill), so the property docstring "never swapped" holds within kinds.
R2 FIXED. "Outside Naadi" wraps onto two lines inside the assessment card at iPad landscape (screens/16 planner-suggestion--webkit-ipad-landscape.png). The new e2e asserts the chip stays inside its card and isn't clipped. planner.spec 2x --retries=0 on webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape/phone-390 + chromium-laptop-1440: 33 passed, 3 skipped (push SW test is Chromium-only), 0 failed, both runs.
  Non-blocking nit (pre-existing): in the same card, the "Assessment" chip sits about 2px past the card's right border at iPad landscape. Fold it into a later polish pass.

Environment note: my fresh local DB needed seeding before e2e (the first attempt failed with onboarding 422 no_template on an unseeded DB, not an app defect). Local containers only; the Space and the hosted DB were untouched.
